info.title: OG Image
info.summary: Generate a social-card image from a title, subtitle and logo.
info.description:
Renders an Open Graph or Twitter card image with your text on a clean template and returns the PNG, JPEG or WebP bytes. Cards are cached, so repeated requests for the same parameters cost nothing and answer with an `ETag`.

Because the image URL usually goes in a `<meta property="og:image">` tag where no header can be sent, the endpoint also accepts a **signed URL**: add `k=<key id>` and `sig=<signature>` instead of the Authorization header. The signature is the first 40 hex characters of `HMAC-SHA256(secret, canonical query)`, where the canonical query is every parameter except `sig`, sorted by name and RFC 3986 encoded, and the secret is the signing secret shown for the key in the console.

get.description: Titles wrap to three lines and are scaled to fit. Text is always escaped; HTML is not interpreted. A logo is fetched once, embedded in the render and never hot-linked.

cached.description: Whether the card came from the cache.

parameters.name: title
parameters.example: Ship faster with the Zactonz APIs

parameters.name: subtitle
parameters.example: Screenshots, QR codes, link previews and more

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Short label shown at the bottom, for example your domain, up to 60 characters.

parameters.name: logo
parameters.description: Public URL of a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG logo, up to 512 KB.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: `card` (accent bar and logo), `minimal` (centred) or `split` (text beside an accent panel).

parameters.name: accent
parameters.description: Accent colour as six hex digits.

parameters.name: bg
parameters.description: Background colour as six hex digits, overriding the theme.

parameters.name: resp
parameters.description: `image` streams the bytes. `json` returns a hosted link valid for seven days.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Key id, only for signed URLs.

x-status-codes.title: Bad request
x-status-codes.description: `title` is missing or a parameter is out of range.

x-status-codes.title: Logo unavailable
x-status-codes.description: The logo URL did not return an image.

x-status-codes.title: Renderer busy
x-status-codes.description: All render slots are in use. Retry after a few seconds.

x-status-codes.title: Timeout
x-status-codes.description: Rendering did not finish within the time limit.

x-status-codes.title: Unauthorized
x-status-codes.description: The Authorization header is missing or the key is not recognised.

x-status-codes.title: Forbidden
x-status-codes.description: The key is not licensed for this product.

x-status-codes.title: Too many requests
x-status-codes.description: The per-minute rate or the plan quota is exhausted. Retry after the seconds given in `Retry-After`.
